verdict.rationale: Pilot's pricing page lists "Full accounts payable" as a service tier feature and says it integrates with Bill.com. That suggests AP is handled as a done-for-you service or through a third-party bill-pay tool, not as a native single workflow. Nothing documents how bills are captured, routed for approval or scheduled for payment. Missing for 10: documented bill capture/ingestion, approval routing, payment scheduling, evidence that these run in one native workflow rather than via Bill.com, and independent corroboration of the AP workflow.
